import pyautogui, time; pyautogui.click(1000, 400); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','a'); time.sleep(0.3); c='Sub DoReorder
Dim n(9) As String
n(0)="ReadMe"
n(1)="Raw_data"
n(2)="Beans"
n(3)="Millet"
n(4)="Sorghum"
n(5)="Mkt Gotheye"
n(6)="Mkt Mangaize"
n(7)="Mkt Ouallam"
n(8)="Mkt Tera"
n(9)="Millet spatial integration"
oE = StarDesktop.Components.createEnumeration()
Do While oE.hasMoreElements()
o = oE.nextElement()
If HasUnoInterfaces(o, "com.sun.star.frame.XModel") Then
If InStr(o.getURL(), "sample-database") > 0 Then
d = o
End If
End If
Loop
s = ""
For i = 0 To 9
If d.Sheets.hasByName(n(i)) Then
d.Sheets.moveByName(n(i), i)
Else
s = s & "MISS " & n(i) & Chr(10)
End If
Next i
r = ""
For i = 0 To d.Sheets.Count - 1
r = r & d.Sheets.getByIndex(i).Name & Chr(10)
Next i
d.store()
MsgBox s & "==" & Chr(10) & r
End Sub'; pyautogui.write(c, interval=0.008); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('f5')
memo: Typed DoReorder macro in Module1 and pressed F5. It moves sheets to order ReadMe,Raw_data,Beans,Millet,Sorghum,Mkt Gotheye,Mkt Mangaize,Mkt Ouallam,Mkt Tera,Millet spatial integration, calls store(), then MsgBox lists final order (and MISS lines if a name was wrong). Next: read MsgBox, verify, click OK.
